notes.title: Weeklong Deals is Here! 40% Off for Multishop Tycoon Deluxe!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27997093/ad2ef35d8e087a3013e21b811448f558e6ff8749.png

Hello guys :D

We have good news for you. Multishop Tycoon is joining Weeklong Deals! Start from April 5, 2021 until April 12, 2021, we will give you 40% off for Multishop Tycoon Deluxe!

In Multishop Tycoon Deluxe you will start and grow your company and become the best food business in the city. Find the perfect combination of favorite goods, days, places, investment deals, and best strategies to optimize the sales and profit you gain. Every decision you make might affect your sales, so be careful with your movement.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/568780/Multishop_Tycoon_Deluxe/

We only can give you this big offer in one week. Go grab it fast and let's become the best businessman in the city.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Try Our Other Games Too!!

Our other games are also joining the Weeklong Deals too! You should check it out!

Legion Tale
Take part in the story set in Agia, a continent inflicted with conflicts between two races. Join Alan, a young man from Scarleta who leads a small legion of warriors, to take over the reign of Dark Lord. Find the true reason behind the conquest for Agia in this tactical turn-based game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/604040/Legion_Tale/

Aquaculture Land: Fish Farming Simulation
Aquaculture Land is a fish farming management game. You will act as a freshwater fish farm manager to nurture different varieties of fish, produce high-quality commodities, and fulfill your customers' needs to grow your business.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land_Fish_Farming_Simulation/

Lobster Empire
Lobster Empire is a game in which you build up your own lobster business, developing better fishing techniques and ways to create long-lasting and profitable lobster resources.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/665960/Lobster_Empire/

We’ll be waiting for you guys!
Cheers!

notes.title: Big update is live for everyone!
notes.content:
Hey there!

Did all of you enjoy the summer sale? Together with this sale, we decided to give you all a brand new competitive updates, and its not only one! We create two new mode that runs a bit different with the main game! If we call the main game with Quest Mode, then the new ones are Sprint Mode and Challenge Mode! This mode designed to extend the gameplay time and give player chance to compete with others using leaderboard.
 
Sprint Mode will challenge you to play with defined amount of days. You’ll tasked to gain profit as many as possible in this limited days. Then the score you have will be ranked with other players. The more you gain, the higher you reach. Players can see their scores on the leaderboard for Sprint Mode.
 
The next one is Challenge Mode. Similar with the quest features in the Quest Mode but with a little tweak in the mechanic. Now you have to finish the task within the defined time. Let say the mode will have you sell 100 goods, but you need to achieve it only in three days! Each time you succeed, the reward will be given. You also have freedom which challenge you want to finish first. The profit you gain will translates to scores and put to the leaderboard for Challenge Mode.
 
Have fun compete with other players!
 
Let’s conclude it then, this update will features:

Sprint Mode and Challenge Mode.
Play with limited days in Sprint Mode
Three level with different limitation for Sprint Mode: 15, 30, and 60 days.
A specific set of foods for each level in Sprint Mode.
Challenge Mode will challenge you to sell a specific amount of goods in defined days.
New leaderboard for each new modes.

 
Future Plan
We have a grand plan to translate our game into another language, especially in Turkish, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, France, Portuguese-Brazil and Germany. This major language update will happen near in the future. Please look forward to it!
